2607.09503.title: What VGGT Knows About Overlap: Probing Geometric Foundation Models for Co-Visibility
2607.09503.paper_summary: A fundamental challenge in 3D reconstruction and robotic localization is co-visibility: determining which image pairs share overlapping visible surfaces, particularly in scenarios with minimal overlap. We demonstrate that VGGT implicitly encodes co-visibility as an emergent behavior: without any supervision for this task, its internal representations exhibit a clear hierarchical structure mirroring that of large language models, i.e. early layers build a 3D-aware scene representation, while late layers act as dedicated co-visibility reasoners. In particular, we identify layer L17 as a negative anchor that consistently routes non-co-visible pairs for this backbone, regardless of the evaluation setting, providing task-grounded evidence of layer specialization in a geometry-grounded foundation model. Building on this, we introduce Co-VGGT, which freezes VGGT and trains only a lightweight layer-wise mixture-of-experts head (less than 7.5M parameters) to classify co-visibility from RGB alone, treating each layer as a specialized expert whose geometric abstraction is adaptively weighted per input pair. On the Co-VisiON benchmark, Co-VGGT surpasses the human annotation baseline and improves over prior work by more than 25% pairwise and 10% multiview. Pairwise predictions are well-calibrated (ECE=0.030), enabling direct use as edge weights in visibility graphs for downstream SfM and SLAM pipelines without post-hoc correction. Code and data are available.
2607.09503.paper_summary_zh: 一個在 3D 重建和機器人定位中的基本挑戰是共可見性：確定哪些圖像對共享重疊的可見表面，特別是在重疊最小的情境中。我們展示了 VGGT 以一種新興行為隱式編碼共可見性：在這項任務上沒有任何監督的情況下，其內部表現顯示出明確的層次結構，與大型語言模型的結構相呼應，即早期層構建一個 3D 感知的場景表示，而後期層則作為專門的共可見性推理者。特別地，我們識別出 L17 層作為一個負錨點，無論評估設置如何，始終將非共可見對路由到這個主幹，提供了基於任務的證據，證明了幾何基礎模型中的層專業化。在此基礎上，我們介紹了 Co-VGGT，該模型凍結 VGGT，僅訓練一個輕量級的層級混合專家頭（少於 7.5M 參數）來僅根據 RGB 分類共可見性，將每層視為一個專門的專家，其幾何抽象根據每對輸入自適應加權。在 Co-VisiON 基準上，Co-VGGT 超越了人類標註基線，並在成對和多視圖上分別提高了超過 25% 和 10%。成對預測經過良好校準（ECE=0.030），使其能夠直接用作可見性圖中的邊緣權重，用於下游的 SfM 和 SLAM 流程，而無需事後修正。代碼和數據均可用。
